Description: Calendar date of the metric in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Support channel for which metrics are reported (e.g. Phone, Chat, Email, Web Form, Community).
Count of contacts offered to the channel on that date (includes answered and abandoned contacts).
Count of contacts answered/handled by agents in the channel on that date.
Count of contacts that were abandoned before being answered; typically offered_contacts - answered_contacts.
Average handle time for answered contacts in the channel on that date, measured in seconds.
Average speed of answer for the channel on that date, measured in seconds (time from contact initiation to agent answer).
First Contact Resolution rate for the channel on that date, expressed as a percentage (0–100).
Agent occupancy for the channel on that date, expressed as a percentage (0–100).
Estimated staffing hours consumed by the channel on that date, based on handled volume, AHT, and occupancy.
Estimated labor cost in USD for the channel on that date, derived from staffing hours and assumed hourly cost.
